decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 5 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 6 - The premises shall be used for an office for a supported housing officer in relation to tenants of 86-88 Wellington Road South and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class A2 or B1 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).

Condition : 7 - Details of the proposed cycle storage shall be submitted to and approved by Council prior to commencement of works on site.  The proposed cycle storage is to be secure and able to protect cycles from the elements
description: Erection of a detached single storey office for supported housing officer.
